## Goal

One sentence: what is true when this is done.

## Acceptance

The eval in plain English. The lane writes this eval first; it must fail before the implementation and pass after. If it cannot be turned into a failing test, say so here and label the issue `blocked`.

## Touches

Files or packages the work lives in (the tool allowlist is derived from this).

## Size

S | M | L

## Depends

Row ids or issue numbers that must be merged first, or `none`.

## Door

two-way | one-way (stops for the owner before code)
